Moth Signal is an offline Morse-code listening game. Gameplay does not use accounts, ads, analytics or a remote server. Your current game is held in memory and resets when the app process or web view restarts.

No microphone, camera, or location access is needed. Sound is generated on your device after you tap Play; you can switch sound and flashes off independently. With both off, written-only play keeps full points. Flashes start off when the device requests reduced motion. Playback stops when you leave the app. Reference links open external websites only when selected.

This is a development test build, version 0.1.1. It has not been submitted to the App Store or Google Play. Fictional moths and radio-tower stories are used as a game setting.
